Definition: properly, extension, i.e. height or breadth; also a measure (including its standard); hence a portion (as measured) or a vestment; specifically, tribute (as measured)
BiblicalUsage: 1) measure, measurement, stature, size, garment; 1a) measure, act of measurement; 1b) measurement, size; 1c) measured portion, extent; 1d) garment; 2) (BDB) tribute
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
